terminal_disclosures.boundary: These are terminal, disclosed states with evidence/reopen conditions; they are not promoted to reviewed.

formal_generation_rules: Formal mode is separate from legacy per-batch --release and from --candidate.
Formal PDF must contain no draft/candidate labels.
Formal practice pages and preface must be explicitly labeled v0.4.0 formal release.
Back matter must retain source-blocked/fail-closed disclosure and identify current release as v0.4.0.
Generated formal artifact is not considered repository-released until final visual QA, manifest registration, deliverables/releases archival, target-HEAD CI, and release record all pass.
